name: Hetzner Object Storage

storage.note: Storage beyond the base price's 1 TB costs EUR 0.0087 per TB-hour; objects smaller than 64 kB are billed as 64 kB.

baseFee.note: Billed hourly (EUR 0.0104) for every hour at least one bucket exists, even an empty one, capped at EUR 6.49 a month; it includes 1 TB of storage and 1 TB of egress for all buckets of the account together.

egress.note: Egress beyond the base price's 1 TB costs EUR 1.00 per TB; ingress is free.

transactions.note: S3 API requests are free; only the egress they cause is billed.

notes: Metadata is billed as storage too; sotyware cannot measure it, so the estimate can be slightly low.
Old versions are stored data on buckets with versioning switched on.
